meaning: Formal fact, from no premises: on the reading by attribution Aristotle's cause-is-more-such principle holds for the primary and fails in general. So at being the frontier premise STMT-CAUSE-OF-QUALITY-IN-ANOTHER-IS-MORE-SUCH needs re-reading: restricted to the primary as cause it is derivable; unrestricted it is the synonymous (univocal) principle of Met. II.1.
